description: This Java class 'CommandSourceService' manages transactional processing of command sources in the Fineract platform, including saving initial commands, handling results, error generation, and command processing with maker-checker logic.

classes.name: CommandSourceService
classes.description: Service class for managing command source lifecycle, including saving, processing, and sanitizing commands with transaction management and maker-checker logic.

methods.name: saveInitialNewTransaction
methods.description: Saves initial command source in a new transaction with REPEATABLE_READ isolation.

methods.name: saveInitialSameTransaction
methods.description: Saves initial command source within the current transaction.

methods.name: saveInitial
methods.description: Internal method to create and save initial command source, handling unique constraint exceptions.

methods.name: saveResultNewTransaction
methods.description: Saves command result in a new transaction.

methods.name: saveResultSameTransaction
methods.description: Saves command result within the current transaction.

methods.name: saveResult
methods.description: Internal method to persist command source.

methods.name: getCommandSource
methods.description: Retrieves command source by ID in a new transaction.

methods.name: findCommandSource
methods.description: Finds command source by wrapper and idempotency key.

methods.name: getInitialCommandSource
methods.description: Creates a new command source entry with 'UNDER_PROCESSING' status and sanitizes JSON if needed.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes a command with maker-checker validation and transaction control.

methods.name: sanitizeJson
methods.description: Sanitizes specified JSON keys in command source, masking sensitive data.
